correctness.rationale: The overlap classification counts 3 two-edge-overlap, 6(n-3) one-edge-overlap and remaining disjoint wedges per triangle; and 1 same, 3(n-3) shared-edge, remaining disjoint triangles. Hypergeometric edge-union probabilities yield the two displayed finite moments; exact symbolic rational factorization confirmed the closed covariance; sign numerator is positive on the stated range; boundary statistics are deterministic. Replacing the hypergeometric probabilities by p^r gives the stated Bernoulli sign threshold. Exact-rational direct-graph enumeration corroborates independently.

value.rationale: Two elementary but central network-closure statistics (complete and open triads) exhibit provably universal negative covariance under a fixed-edge null, whereas the corresponding independent-edge null has a sharp density-dependent sign reversal. The all-n, all-m exact calibration gives materially different dependence predictions for conditional vs unconditional random-graph inference and is not merely a parameter substitution or known count recomputation; the nontrivial global sign follows from substantial overlap cancellation.
